quest.title: A New Pilgrimage
quest.description: At Iansan's request, you and Mavuika help test the competition process...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x675, Mora x49200, Hero's Wit x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x11

talks.objective: Return to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Here you go. What lies before you is a mock-up of the course that will be used for the upcoming tournament.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean... this entire thing!?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: If it's for the Pilgrimage, it's gotta be grand.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: That's right. I've designed this one to make use of the Stadium's maximum capacity, and I've given thought to every space, every placement, and every dimension.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: See this kindling?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Contestants will have to chase it throughout the competition, encountering all kinds of terrain, and they'll prove themselves by using their abilities to overcome anything and everything that stands in their way. That's the focus of this course.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ooh, so that's the kind of competition this is.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Yep, this round counts as a knockout round. There'll be other events as well, and the eight contestants with the highest total scores will move onto the final individual battles.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you're keeping those?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Yeah, everyone loves a good duel. It really gets the adrenaline pumping, and allows people to go all-out with their skills.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: A warrior should always feel fortunate to meet their match on the battlefield, even if it only happens once in their life... No one can resist such a good fight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the most Natlan thing Paimon's ever heard! This tournament, too. It's just so... you.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Oh? Why do you say that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, the competition's all about chasing the kindling, and you're all chasing something, too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Ooh, that's a good metaphor. That'll come in handy when I'm explaining my ideation process later...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Well, I'm glad you found this helpful.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: #The benefits of having Paimon and {NICKNAME} as friends and teachers!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Alright, well... Judging by your faces... You look like you're raring to go, Mavuika, so why don't you try it first?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: No problem. I'll go get ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Mavuika looks so excited! She must really be looking forward to this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She might be a little too excited about the competition...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you... think that she seems a little bit different? After the war and all?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Like, y'know, maybe in her sense of playfulness? She seems less serious than before. More willing to just loosen up and have fun.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Nope, you're not hallucinating. I agree!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, you heard too? So Paimon's right, right?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Yeah! The side of her that she hid during the war has now come out. Makes sense, though — everyone wants to unwind a bit after accomplishing an important goal.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: She's really earned it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, so that's why you called us over? It's all a part of your grand plan, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Not exactly. I did expect Mavuika to take this one, though, so I also planned some other events for you.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Hah, spare the flattery. It'll be awkward if you end up complaining that you're tired later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Coach, what about Paimon? Does she not even get to be a substitute?

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Ahem. You have not yet met the basic criteria to even begin training. Practice a few more years and come back, and then we'll see.

talks.objective: Test the competition process for Iansan

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: That should be enough data and feedback on my end for now. Thanks for all the help, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: No, we should be thanking you. Both the mock course and the ball launcher were fantastic. I didn't know you were so good at making things like this.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Ah, you flatter me. It wasn't all my own handiwork — I contracted out a part of the work you gave me to Xilonen.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: She was a little reluctant, but once I mentioned that you were the one who had asked me to find some helpers, she volunteered to help.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Looks like I also have you to thank for her negative views about me... How much would you say you contributed? Thirty percent?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Absolutely not, I'd say ten at most. Please do not blame your problems on me.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: #Your attendance was a pleasant surprise, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. I didn't think you'd have time to try the ball launcher out for at least a few more days... Thanks for coming.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, you know what they say, embrace the unexpected!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for having us, Iansan.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Well, I'm just glad that you had fun. Y'know, we should probably call it a day.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I need to get going now, anyway. Those improvements won't make themselves. See you later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bye! See you soon!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bye, Coach!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: See you soon, Coach!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Whew, it's not every day that I get to call Iansan that... Did you see the look on her face? She almost jumped out of her own skin, ahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You kinda enjoy messing with people, don't you...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Really? I never noticed.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Anyway, we've been out and about so long... You must be hungry. Come on, let's go get some grub. My treat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha—? Okay, Paimon takes it all back! You're the best person ever!

talks.objective: Return to the starting point and talk to Iansan

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Huh? Did you go the wrong way?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: No worries, we can just start over again. Let me know when you're ready.

talks.objective: Test the competition process for Iansan

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Without him around, it's so peaceful and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Phew... Not bad.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Course complete!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good job, contestant! Here, have some water!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Now that was exciting!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: You're too kind. Thank you, my dear audience, and thank you, Coach!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Well, what do you think? First things first, let me just say that the enemies at the end were definitely not part of the plan... the device... never did anything before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe it can't detect anyone under a certain height...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: ...In which case, you would've been fine, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Good point.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It's a solid course, but there are a number of small problems.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: For example, take the chase at the start. I feel like it's too short to separate the best from the rest. Why don't you find a few more people to test it out and adjust the distance based on their feedback?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, you're really thorough! And yeah, getting multiple opinions is a great idea!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Also, about the vertical section. It's only so-so, and contestants might get dizzy from the sudden change of direction, which might cause some of them to fall if they get motion sickness.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Also...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Got it all down.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Couldn't have spotted any of these issues without actually running the course... Thanks for your help, Mavuika. I'll keep making improvements based on these suggestions.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: #That reminds me of something I was talking to {NICKNAME} about, actually — I've got a ball launcher here. Want to give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A ball launcher?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this one of the "other events" that you mentioned?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Yup! Ball sports are also a proud, ancient tradition here in Natlan. I've decided to use one for an event.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It's been a long time since I last saw gear like this. This game can be played by two, three, or four people, and it's a fun one.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: #Want to give it a try, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Great. I'll be your opponent, then.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: In that case, get into position, you two, and I'll start the clock. Whoever has the higher score when the clock runs out wins.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Thank you for agreeing to be my opponent.

talks.objective: Try out the ball launcher with Mavuika

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As expected, you're a pro, Mavuika... I concede.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: You played well. We can play a few more rounds when we have the time.

talks.objective: Try out the ball launcher with Mavuika

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Warming up before a competition is extremely important. Don't ever forget.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hey there, Boss, I'm here with some guests. I'll have the usual.

dialogues.speaker: Hinchei
dialogues.text: Ah, Pyro Archon! Welcome, welcome. It's been a while. Glad to see you with our new heroes, too.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: #Boss, this is {NICKNAME}, and this is Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nice to meet you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi there!

dialogues.speaker: Hinchei
dialogues.text: Hehe, greetings to you both as well. You'll have the same as before, then?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: We worked out today, so yeah, that would be great.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Erm, so, what is "the usual"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We can just have some snacks. Paimon already eats too much as it is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, come on, {NICKNAME}! You've never been stingy even when we were low on Mora, so why are you're going after Paimon's food now that someone's treating us?

dialogues.speaker: Hinchei
dialogues.text: #Hahaha, you two are a riot. I get where {NICKNAME}'s coming from, though. You're too cute not to tease, Miss Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: If someone's down in the dumps, your banter can cheer them right up. That's not just from me, by the way. I've heard it from plenty of other people.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ehh? F—For real? So, were you teasing Paimon on purpose, {NICKNAME}...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course. You can eat as much as you want.

dialogues.speaker: Hinchei
dialogues.text: Just leave it to us! Please wait a moment — your food will be out shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Alright — eat your fill, Paimon, but just remember the tournament is in three days. So try and make sure your food coma is finished by then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What, what? Food coma? ...Hmph, dunno what you're talking about. Paimon will be there on time, don't you worry.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you've also grown fond of teasing Paimon, Mavuika.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Haha, don't worry. In the event that you do oversleep a bit, I have my ways of waking you up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? You do? Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! Speaking of your "ways," Mavuika, you still haven't told us about how you plan to find Xbalanque!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Oh, that? It's actually quite simple.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Xbalanque is a native of Natlan. The records speak of him as a wise, brave, and upright man, and refer to him as "The First Sun."

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: People like that tend to be like me, passionate about competition. The more they disdain dishonest ways of winning, the more they'll celebrate a fair victory.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: You could call that a trait shared by all the heroes of Natlan. They are full of energy and passion, and despise victories born of deceit. Conversely, they're constantly drawn to things that are full of hope and excitement.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean... Xbalanque might want to take part in this upcoming Pilgrimage?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It's not a matter of "might." He will.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It's precisely because such an important figure will be participating that we must prepare the best tournament possible.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Checking in on the various tribes was also to ensure that we'll be prepared to give him a warm welcome.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: So... all we need to do is to look for him in the Stadium on that day. As the first Pyro Archon, he should have no problem running away with the whole competition.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, isn't it a bit unfair for the Pyro Archon themselves to participate in such a tournament? After all, everyone else is just an ordinary human...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: When Xbalanque ascended to archonhood, he did so as a human. I see no problem in allowing him to participate in this event as a "human" from ancient times.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Also, my ineligibility for the event is not due to being Archon, but due to my obligation to serve as host and judge.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, that's kinda like your life as Archon... You haven't lost your human side, you're just too busy to indulge it...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Oh? Another good summary. I'll be sure to write it down and include it in my autobiography.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're working on an autobiography!?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: No, I was joking. Even Xbalanque didn't write one, so why would I? Still, if on the off-chance I ever did write one, you two'd definitely be in it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then... can Paimon have a super long title?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Sure, as long as you want.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The restaurant owner walks towards you with massive plates piled high with food in her hands, and Paimon is so excited that she can't stop spinning in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So many dishes, and such huge portions, too! Paimon spies mountains of meat as well... Wowee!!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hmm? You know this is just a normal breakfast, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, what!?

dialogues.speaker: Hinchei
dialogues.text: Our Archon's always had a healthy appetite. Hehe, please enjoy the food while it's still hot. Food never tastes as good once it gets cold.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The diligently prepared dishes are extremely delicious, and the two of you immediately begin to dig in.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: And before you know it, Mavuika has polished off half of the grilled meat with elegance, serenity, and astonishing alacrity.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Paimon turns towards you with a frightened look. She realizes that she has met a truly terrifying opponent. From this day forth, Paimon can no longer claim the crown of the greatest meat eater.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Judging the state Paimon ate herself into, I assume you'll be staying someplace close by?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that okay? Ehehe, actually, since it's so beautiful around here, we were planning to stay in the area for a few more days anyway, see the sights and all that!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Of course you can. I'll go arrange some accommodations for you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Mavuika leaves the table briefly, before coming back and taking you to your lodgings.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll leave you here. Have a good rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, good night!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How do you feel? Want another drink?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm good... I'm full.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then... how about some dessert? Paimon still wants something sweet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are you looking at Paimon like that? There's always room for dessert!

dialogues.speaker: Enthusiastic Man
dialogues.text: Lord Xbalanque is coming back, huh? Well, I didn't see that coming... Wait, what's that look on your face? Don't tell me you don't even know who Xbalanque is?

dialogues.speaker: Woman in Deep Thought
dialogues.text: What kind of idiot do you take me for!? I was just thinking about it!

dialogues.speaker: Woman in Deep Thought
dialogues.text: I mean, we just managed to defeat the Abyss for good, and fulfill the wish of all citizens of Natlan, past and present... So why is he coming back now, of all times?

dialogues.speaker: Enthusiastic Man
dialogues.text: Yeah, if he's here to help, the war's already over. And if he isn't...

dialogues.speaker: Enthusiastic Man
dialogues.text: ...Uh, I just had a terrifying thought. What if he's actually some kind of villain who's come to steal our victory? Isn't that how the novels usually go?

dialogues.speaker: Woman in Deep Thought
dialogues.text: What? No! Don't be ridiculous! Novels are just fiction! Don't you slander our great hero. You're talking about Lord Xbalanque here, the one everyone calls The First Sun!

dialogues.speaker: Woman in Deep Thought
dialogues.text: Also, even if what you said were true, I don't think our Archon would lose! We all saw that one punch of hers. The power in it was like... Hah!

dialogues.speaker: Enthusiastic Man
dialogues.text: Yeah, I agree, but I'll bet Lord Xbalanque's no slouch, either! Say, if they fought, who do you think would win?

dialogues.speaker: Woman in Deep Thought
dialogues.text: ...Argh... Well, you've got me there.

dialogues.speaker: Woman in Deep Thought
dialogues.text: Well, as someone living in this age, I've got to vote for our Archon, right? Live in the now, seize the day, and all that.

dialogues.speaker: Enthusiastic Man
dialogues.text: Man, now that you mention it, a fight between those two is bound to be a terrific one... What I wouldn't give to watch!

dialogues.speaker: Woman in Deep Thought
dialogues.text: Alright, enough of that nonsense. It's already super late. If we keep hyping ourselves up, neither of us are gonna get any sleep tonight!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The way they're talking about the archons duelling each other almost makes it sound like a beetle battle...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Way more exciting than a beetle battle, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! They really do love their contests of strength here in Natlan...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I'm looking forward to the tournament myself. How will the matches go? And who's going to come out on top?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Will the legendary Xbalanque really participate? If he wins the whole thing, will Mavuika preside over the victory ceremony, too? The more I think about it, the more interesting it gets...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew! Alright. Paimon's done eating. Let's head back and get some sleep!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Paimon spend the next three days strolling around, eating, drinking, and relaxing to your hearts' content...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: At last, the day of the tournament arrives.

talks.objective: Return to your accommodation and rest

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I managed to force the great Pyro Archon to a draw!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Indeed you did. I've noticed that you're very good at games. And now that I've found such a great opponent, we've got to have a rematch sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Hey! Wake up! Wake up! The tournament's about to start!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...That voice... Ah, it's Paimon...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Wait, the tournament!?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, we've overslept! Only a little bit, but... Okay, wash up and pack your things! We've gotta go go go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaaaah, Paimon can't believe it, Mavuika totally called it! How could we have been so careless!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this what people mean when they say you can get so excited before a trip that you struggle to sleep the night before, only to miss setting out the next day...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hey there. How are you feeling?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mavuika! Why are you here!? Isn't the tournament about to begin?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We know, it's our fault! We're really sorry!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Yeah, we're about to start. I'm here to pick you up.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Put on your helmets, and get on the bike.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Can we make it in time?

choices.text: I'll hang on to you, Paimon, don't worry!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Sit down and sit tight. You can hold on to my waist if you get scared.

choices.text: Paimon doesn't count as a passenger, so we're not overloaded!

talks.objective: Go to the Stadium with Mavuika

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Woohoo! Annnd SAFE! Just in time, too!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: We won the bet! We won the bet!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That's right! Pay up, Ajaw!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Yeah, pay up, Ajaw!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Pay up.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Tch! Darn it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaaaah— Oof!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: How'd you like that? A short flamestrider show to start us off, and to introduce and welcome Natlan's great friend, "Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini"!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Woohoo!!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Sure pulled off that stunt pretty neatly.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: How can you call that a stu— Wait... What do you mean, "pulled it off"? That wasn't supposed to be part of the show?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Everyone, welcome back to the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame. Once more, I will say a few words before we begin.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Bored? Heard it all before? Not to worry. We're doing things differently from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: The Abyss no longer threatens us day and night as it once did. My comrades, my friends, thank you for your hard work and sacrifice. We have achieved a lasting victory. A new day has dawned on Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Woooooo!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: From now on, the Pilgrimage will no longer serve as the prelude to a war waged to defend our land. However, many aspects of it will remain the same.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It remains a trial to determine the strongest among us, as well as a stage upon which to showcase your individual growth.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Today marks the beginning of yet another legendary saga — one written in the triumphs of the victors! So, without further ado... Let the tournament begin!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Yeah!!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Heck yeah!! Who's gonna be the new champion!?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Now then, you two. You'll be mobile supervisors, moving with the contestants as they progress, and making sure that everything is proceeding fairly and in good order.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Leave it to us! We're the best adventurer and travel guide duo you'll ever meet!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Oh, and one more thing. I believe I've mentioned this already, but...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: If you find any leads on Lord Xbalanque, please pass them onto me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will do.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Thanks. I'm counting on you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Kinich! Gonna take part in the tournament?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Of course. I wouldn't dream of missing such a rare opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Best of luck! You can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Where's Ajaw, though?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I locked him in a chest. I'm going to win the tournament solely on my own merit, so he's not needed during the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! Hmm, on a different note, have you heard anything about Lord Xbalanque?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I've looked all over, but haven't seen anyone that struck me as being on his level.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's touch base again later, then.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're reliable as always, Kinich! We should go check with the others now, so we'll see you later. Good luck, and make sure you don't get injured!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Appreciate it. Wish you guys every success as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, hi there, Iansan! Are you gonna participate in the tournament?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: No, as the designer of this course, that's out of the question.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I'm here to cheer everyone on and monitor the pre-event warm-up. Contestants must limber up properly if they don't want to get injured.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's fair. Can we ask you something, then? You know about Lord Xbalanque's resurrection, right? Have you seen anyone with that kind of aura over here?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Yeah, the others told me about it.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I've kept an eye out, but haven't noticed anything unusual. At least, I haven't seen any contestant whose strength or skill is clearly a cut above the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it, thank you! We'll keep asking around, then.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: You're welcome... Wait, one moment!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: You warm up as well. You'll be running alongside them in the Stadium, so you've got to go in prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Stretch! Lower! Again! Good!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Iansan corners you, and coerces the two of you into going through a round of warm-ups. Her coach's aura is simply too commanding to resist.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Alright, you're good. You may go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, thank you, Coach... Paimon feels like even her blood is boiling...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Hah—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa!!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: #Oh? Well, hey there, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. What brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To see the lovely Miss Itztli.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: You...! Hmph, I'm not buying what you're selling!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} means it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, Paimon didn't think you'd be taking part, Citlali. Given who you are, are you sure it isn't against the rules?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Though not a violation per se, what it will be is an unpleasant surprise for the youngsters.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Normally, I stay out of this kind of event — don't want to put too much pressure on everyone else. But we're celebrating the end of the war here, so I'll give the occasion the respect it deserves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good luck, then! Make sure you show off your super-majestic side, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Well, aren't you the sweet-talker today? Too much syrup on your pancakes this morning?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you both. I'll remember your words of encouragement, and do my best.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So what was that "Hmm... Hah!" thing all about? Some kinda strange ritual?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Of course not. I was using my power to search for Lord Xbalanque.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: To be more precise, I was trying to look for him in the world of souls. After all, I also have no idea what he might look like...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: But why? He is the first Pyro Archon, after all, isn't it a given that he'll be revived with an unimaginably large amount of power?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like we'll have to keep looking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we don't have any leads yet... We'll check for leads somewhere else. Good luck, Granny, and take care!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Be on your way, now. Oh, and take care of yourselves, too. Granny Itztli will display her dashing self on the competition grounds soon enough.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: One, two, three four, two, two, three four...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How's the warm-up going, Kachina? Feeling good?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Oh, hey you two! Yeah, I'm feeling great! Ready to get out there and show 'em who's boss, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck! Bring it home.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Mhm! I'll give it my all!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I mean, I don't know if I'll be able to win again, but as long as I learn something from the experience, that's enough of a win for me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, having the right mindset is everything!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Yup!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way, have you seen anyone who seems like Lord Xbalanque?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Lord Xbalanque? Hmm... I don't think so!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: A powerful figure like him is sure to attract attention wherever he goes. Like Mualani and Kinich — only even more so.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I haven't seen anyone like that, though... So he probably hasn't passed this way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, alright... Thanks, Kachina! We'll go take another look around. Focus on taking care of yourself as well as winning!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I will, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Supervisors, your report, please. How are the contestants doing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Madam host, the contestants are doing great, and the competition is proceeding as scheduled!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: However, when it comes to Xbalanque...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: No leads, huh... The competition is almost about to begin, and there's still no sign of him?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not what you expected?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Not necessarily.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Still, let's go give everyone a warm welcome before we kick off.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: I believe we're all warmed up. Now, take your positions.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: This iteration of the Pilgrimage is the perfect chance for us to bid farewell to the past. Now, go forth and soar, faster, higher, stronger — become a better version of yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Remember what brought you here, and keep pushing forward. This tournament begins... now!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alright! Ready or not, here I come!

dialogues.speaker: Contestant
dialogues.text: Waaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: There's Mualani, a natural sports star! She's not going to stop scoring anytime soon!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I've got this!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: This round's in the bag!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: A vertical course, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Time to leave them all in the dust.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Kinich is coming up to the trickiest parts of the course here, but is he slowing down? NO! He's SPEEDING UP! Amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Contestant
dialogues.text: How's he so fast!?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: See you later.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: The gap between our competitors has increased significantly! Could this mean...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Hah!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Ooh! Contestant Kachina has suddenly appeared from the side!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: This part's rough... but I won't give up!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Ugh! So annoying...

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: The competition has entered its final phase! Who will emerge victorious? We're about to find out!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Got you!

dialogues.speaker: Nlteego
dialogues.text: Aghhh!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Well? Do you yield?

dialogues.speaker: Nlteego
dialogues.text: *sigh* I yield!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Our champion has emerged! And his name is... Kinich!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Kinich! Kinich!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That's amazing! Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's our Kinich! I knew he'd win!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: What!? So not only is the little punk hard to kill, but he's good at fighting too? Hmph. Guess he does have some skill...

dialogues.speaker: Nlteego
dialogues.text: You beat me fair and square, Kinich... People always talk about how tough you are, and now I can say for sure: they're not exaggerating.

dialogues.speaker: Nlteego
dialogues.text: It's funny, I was thinking to myself earlier that I might have a shot at winning this... unless I have to face Kinich in the final.

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Come on, dude! What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Pfft, losing to Kinich isn't really a loss at all!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: You've more than proven yourself, too! You could beat me up thirty times over!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Ha. Hear that? They're recognizing your strength as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Keep up the good work. Let's have a rematch sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Nlteego
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're both so good... But wait, if that's the end, where's Xbalanque?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Wait, aren't we missing someone? Ah! Lord Xbalanque!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it... Where is he? Don't tell me...

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: What's with the looks on your faces? I might have won, but I'm not Xbalanque.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Huh!? Are you saying that you BEAT Xbalanque, then? Urgh, just kill me now! Better death than to suffer this torture! What a joke!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Hmm. You might be onto something... I've never met our runner-up before. So... Where did you get this good?

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: That's impossible, right? Could he have placed so well because of some connection with Lord Xbalanque?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: You mean... He might be Xbalanque?

dialogues.speaker: Nlteego
dialogues.text: Wait, I'm Xbalanque now? Heh, that's news to me.

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: I've got it! Lord Xbalanque didn't want to steal anyone's thunder, so he must've lost the tournament on purpose!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Wait, that doesn't make any sense. This is the most holy Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame! How could anyone throw a match?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, did Paimon say something wrong? Now everyone's talking about Xbalanque...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, that guy was almost too good, wasn't he? We've never heard of him before, but he was still going toe to toe with Kinich. Could he really be...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What are you looking at, Mavuika?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: I've felt that something was off since the tournament began.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Reflecting back on it, it wasn't because I could sense Xbalanque's power, but rather that... I could not.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Does she mean that Xbalanque is not present? Or... does she mean that he wasn't resurrected in his original form?)

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Please, excuse me.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Wait, she's going... straight in the direction of the other contestants?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: There you are.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: No unimaginably strong soul aura, nor any whiff of extraordinary power...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: But I know, beyond any doubt, that you are Xbalanque himself.

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Huuuuuuh!?

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Wh—Who's that? I've never seen him before...

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Isn't that Mausau? Like, Tawto's grandson? When did he sign up for the tournament? Did he even fight anyone out on the field?

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: What are you talking about? He's been standing there this whole time. I totally thought he was just there to cheer the others on...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Wait, so THAT'S Xbalanque? But... he's just a kid...
Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Hah! HA! Well, this kid doesn't look like he can take a single punch from the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw! Just give me one second, and I'll...

dialogues.speaker: Nlteego
dialogues.text: Huh? That's Lord Xbalanque? But... I mean, he was right next to me for most of the tournament. And he didn't seem very, well... Xbalanque to me...
...You recognized me? Perceptive. No less than expected of this era's Pyro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Forgive me for asking, but how did you do in the latest tournament?
Haha, I didn't even make it to the final 32.

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Noooooo!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: This is a joke, right? It has to be! It's clearly staged!

dialogues.speaker: Audience
dialogues.text: Out of my way! I've got to see Lord Xbalanque for myself!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: As expected, your return has caused quite the commotion.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Less talking, more doing! Hurry up and take Lord Xbalanque to a safe place. I've got this place covered.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Please remain calm, everyone. Lord Xbalanque is one of the most important people in all of Natlan. I will take responsibility for receiving him into our midst.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: You heard the Archon! Just leave this to her. Don't worry, we'll let you know as soon as we know more!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Mavuika seems to be signaling Paimon and I to follow her...?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, she's calling us! Quick, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Wait up!

talks.objective: Leave the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was a thrilling game! Paimon was on the edge of her seat...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Hmph, this will be a walk in the park.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me! I'll do my best.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Time sure flies, huh? The tournament's taking place tomorrow morning, so let's get some sleep while we can!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go check on everyone and see if we can find any leads on Xbalanque before things kick off!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, seems like we still haven't found any useful clues... Maybe we should just go back and check in with Mavuika.
